programs.title: Bear vs. Shark
programs.desc: Putting his wits and survival skills to the test, adventurer Bear Grylls faces off with the ocean's apex predator  he goes chumming from a helicopter, diving into a feeding frenzy and posing as human bait.

programs.title: The Zoo
programs.sub_title: A Sea Lion Pup Grows Up
programs.desc: Zoo staff face unexpected setbacks weaning a bright sea lion pup off its mother's milk  the bird team steps in to support a rejected curassow chick  a squirrel monkey visits the dentist.

programs.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet: Wild at Heart
programs.desc: Dr. Baier suspects a ferret suffers from a spinal injury after being attacked by the family canine  Dr. Jeff travels to a wolf sanctuary to spay and neuter a desperate pack of wolf-hybrids  three dogs are rescued from an overcrowded shelter.

programs.title: I Was Prey: Feeding Frenzy
programs.desc: Andrea Schlake volunteers at an animal sanctuary when a chimpanzee escapes its enclosure and chases her down  a great white shark knocks surfer Todd Endris off his board and attacks him.

programs.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Bosco the Croc's Big Move
programs.desc: Robert takes on the challenging task of relocating Bosco, the most aggressive croc at the zoo  Bindi must investigate Forest the giraffe's bad knee problem  Terri helps Harley the koala find love at the end of a difficult breeding season.

programs.title: Treetop Cat Rescue: Kitty, Can You Hear Me?
programs.desc: Hostile repeat offender Mow Mow is stuck in yet another tree in Eatonville  Shaun is called to rescue his first-ever deaf cat, Snow, in Seattle.
